title: Binary decrement with borrow
statement: For a finite Boolean list, define a transformation recursively: the empty list maps to itself with borrow flag false; a list beginning with true maps to the list with that first bit changed to false and borrow flag true; and a list beginning with false maps to the list with that bit changed to true, followed by the recursively transformed tail, with the tail's borrow flag.
hypotheses_covered: Input is a finite Boolean list
